exposure: maternal infection with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) in the first trimester
self-reported diagnosis of SARS-CoV-2 in the first trimester
cohort: 3545 pregnant women in the UK aged 18 years or older who conceived during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic and were <13 week's gestation at the time of recruitment
finding: Pregnant women with self-reported diagnosis of SARS-CoV-2 in the first trimester had a higher risk of early miscarriage.
